description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'ActivationDirectory' that manages grain activation contexts within the Orleans runtime. It provides methods for adding, finding, removing, and disposing of activation contexts, and implements collection interfaces for iteration.

classes.name: ActivationDirectory
classes.description: Manages the collection of grain activation contexts, allowing for thread-safe add, removal, find, and disposal operations.

methods.name: ActivationDirectory
methods.description: Constructor that registers an observer for activation count.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the current number of activations.

methods.name: FindTarget
methods.description: Finds the activation context for a given GrainId.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for the collection.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of all activation contexts synchronously.
